title: Ransomware file extension surge
hypothesis: Many files were renamed/changed to ransomware extensions in a short window.
queries: DeviceFileEvents | where FileName endswith ('.lockbit','.enc','.crypt','.hive','.8lock8') | summarize count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m) | where count_ > 50
rationale: Mass extension change = encryption in progress.
